title: Courier card with a late return
body: Transfer window: after road access ends. Return copy to sender. Reverse: “Bread for Mother, no crust if it is still warm.”
rival_reading: A field-delivery schedule could run past a road restriction; the late return line does not identify who changed access.
gloss: A courier's card sets a return after the access window.

title: The key marked for the last run
body: The map's route turns away from the gate. A key tag marked “last run” is tied to its corner, with a thread long enough to reach the road line.
rival_reading: A delayed response crew could carry a key and route map after access changed; the tag could also belong to a field delivery.
gloss: A last-run key points toward a route that no longer reaches its gate.
